Feature: DOM identity preservation

  When the todo list state changes (toggle, add, remove, edit) the render
  function MUST mutate existing DOM nodes in place — toggle classes, set
  .checked, update textContent — rather than rebuilding the list from
  scratch. Rebuilding (whether via innerHTML or removeChild/createElement)
  destroys every existing <li> node, which detaches any browser-held
  reference and causes Cypress acceptance tests to fail with
  "element detached from DOM".

  The fix: diff the existing <li> set against the new model state;
  remove only nodes whose data-id is no longer in the list; reuse the
  rest, mutating their class/checked/textContent in place.

  @conformance
  Scenario: Render function does not rebuild the todo list via innerHTML
    Given the project has a render function that writes to the todo list
    When I check whether the render function assigns innerHTML on the todo-list container
    Then the render function does not use innerHTML reassignment on the todo list

  @conformance
  Scenario: Render function does not unconditionally remove all list-item children
    Given the project has a render function that writes to the todo list
    When I check whether the render function removes all existing list-item children unconditionally
    Then the render function does not remove existing list-item children unless they are stale

  @conformance
  Scenario: Render function reuses existing list-item elements instead of always creating new ones
    Given the project has a render function that writes to the todo list
    When I check whether the render function creates new list-item elements for items that already exist
    Then the render function reuses existing list-item elements for items that are already in the DOM

  @conformance
  Scenario: The event binding helper passes the useCapture flag to addEventListener
    Given the project has an event binding helper function
    When I check whether the helper passes the useCapture argument to addEventListener
    Then the helper passes the useCapture flag to the native addEventListener

  @conformance
  Scenario: Stale-node removal guards against re-entrant blur during removeChild
    Given the project has a render function that writes to the todo list
    When I check whether the render function guards removeChild with a parentNode check in the stale-node removal loop
